plan.experiment: v45 bounded paired from-scratch seed pilot
plan.initialization: Three independent PyTorch random seeds. Within each seed, both trained arms start with exactly its frozen random state. This does not replicate the historical v33/v37 pretraining budget.
plan.paired_data: Identical 3200 identities/order/images for both arms within each seed; distinct disjoint identity ranges across seeds; unchanged corrected-v44 image renderer.
plan.improved_addition: 0.5*[mean(1-cosine(aligned foreground vectors)) + 0.1*variance_floor]. Unit-normalized 48D local vectors; variance_floor=mean(relu(.05-sqrt(var+1e-4)))/.05 averaged over both views. 32 points per identity; only full-image reference/positive dense features. No local negatives.
plan.coefficient_choice: Fixed engineering constants before training or new accuracy inspection; no coefficient sweep.
plan.real_evaluation: Existing USED development records only, one fixed positive reference/class, separate negative FIT/CAL. No new real holdout; retrospective development, not external confirmation.
diagnosis: Global pooled graph-identity ranking can meet synthetic invariances without stable local correspondences.

Earlier local InfoNCE treats other sampled positions as negatives, including potentially equivalent repeated primitives. This is a code-level conflict hypothesis, not a demonstrated causal explanation.
V44 teacher anchoring, partial freezing and own-v37 warm start confound whether its objective transfers from independent random initialization. This pilot removes them identically in both arms.
V44 development evidence and previously consumed test outcomes are known. Only the new synthetic latent identities are untouched; no claim of fresh real confirmation.
plan.research_claim: Noncontrastive local invariance and variance regularization are established ideas. This is an adaptation without covariance penalty/projector, not a reproduction, new theorem, or guarantee of semantic transfer.
limitations: 256 test identities share the training grammar/renderer; four edits per identity are dependent.
Three seeds are a bounded seed check, not a large-run generalization guarantee.
Image identity is narrower than a real semantic category; preserved count/orientation need not be true category invariances.
Variance floor is a soft penalty, not a proof against collapse.
Reference/query raster support accounts for stroke discretization; analytic center geometry correspondence is approximate at raster edges.
